title: console: send the creator's browser timezone when a workspace is created, so a new workspace never shows the timezone prompt (objectui half of cloud#2676)
body:
**⛔ BLOCKED — the request shape is fixed by the cloud half, objectstack-ai/cloud#2676.**

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#2676

Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim. This is the carrier the `repo:cloud` seat asked for on objectstack-ai/cloud#2676 (its seat cannot write to objectui). It is a maintainer-directed task, not a decision card. The maintainer's word, given on the cloud card, verbatim: 「同意，按你说的立卡，不需要决策」.

## Why

The maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2676 replaces the new-workspace half of the objectstack-ai/objectui#11693 B2 ruling: a new workspace takes the creator's browser timezone at creation, and no prompt is shown. Existing workspaces are left as they are.

## What the console does today (read on `main`)

- **Two creation call sites** send no timezone:
  - `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx:183`;
  - `apps/console/src/pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx:162`.
- **The auth package's `createOrganization` type** carries `{ name, slug, logo? }` only (`packages/auth/src/AuthContext.ts:140`; `AuthProvider.tsx:845`).
- **The prompt's own guard** already skips a workspace whose `localization.timezone` is no longer the manifest default: `findTimezoneOffer` returns `null` unless the resolved value's `source` is `default` (`apps/console/src/pages/settings/workspaceTimezonePrompt.ts:204`). So once the cloud half seeds the value through the settings service, the environment surface should stop asking without a code change here. Measure it; do not assume it.

## Scope

1. Both creation call sites send `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone` (the same read as `browserTimeZone()` in the prompt module; `packages/app-shell` cannot import from `apps/console`), in the request shape the cloud half's PR accepts. A missing or empty zone sends nothing.
2. The `createOrganization` type in `packages/auth` gains the optional field the cloud half names. Optional only, so existing callers stay valid.
3. Prompt: confirm on both surfaces (the cloud home and the environment) that a new, seeded workspace does not show `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt`. If a surface still asks, narrow the prompt to workspaces with no seed record there. ⛔ Do not delete the prompt: existing workspaces keep it (「存量不动」).

⛔ Out of scope:
- the welcome-page notice: the welcome page is cloud metadata (cloud `packages/service-tenant/src/pages/welcome.page.ts`), so it rides objectstack-ai/cloud#2676;
- any change to the prompt for existing workspaces.

## Acceptance

- A zh-CN user whose browser zone is `Asia/Shanghai` signs up, creates a workspace and enters the environment. No timezone prompt appears on either surface. The environment's `localization.timezone` reads `Asia/Shanghai`.
- A workspace created before this change, still on the manifest default, gets the prompt exactly as today.
- Unit tests cover both call sites sending the zone, and sending nothing when the browser reports none.

## Related

objectstack-ai/cloud#2676 (cloud half, maintainer ruling) · objectstack-ai/objectui#11693 (B2 ruling, new-workspace half superseded) · objectstack-ai/objectui#11758 (the prompt) · objectstack-ai/cloud#2635 (locale seeding, the same channel)

Duplicate-search terms: workspace timezone prompt, createOrganization timeZone, WorkspaceTimezonePrompt, browser timezone seed
